svg.text: ExpressRoute RoutingWeight (0-32000): Asymmetric Return Trap & Symmetric Fix
Azure Hub Gateway / Virtual WAN Hub
NEVER sent in BGP to MSEE / CE
Shared Hub: shifts ALL spokes to C1!
Family 2 (2.A Bow-Tie / 2.B Single-Side) MSEE Hairpinning Penalty:
- VNet-to-VNet transit over ExpressRoute is DISABLED by default and discouraged by Microsoft.
- Hairpinning VNet 1 <-> VNet 2 via MSEE burns 2x Gateway & Circuit bandwidth + peering RTT.
- Known Issue: After vWAN Route Map upgrade, VNet GW 'Allow remote vWAN traffic' toggle fails
(vWAN prefixes are always learned). Always peer Hubs directly (1.B/1.C) or use Dual vHubs (1.D)!
Fix: Symmetric Egress Weight + Ingress BGP Policy
Azure Hub Gateway / Virtual WAN Hub
vWAN / ARS: Outbound Route Map C2
Clean automatic failover on C1 loss
Production Symmetry Checklist (CLI / IaC Replaces Manual Portal Edits):
1. Standard VNet GW: az network vpn-connection update --routing-weight 100
2. Virtual WAN Hub: az network express-route gateway connection update --routing-weight 100
3. Always pair Azure RoutingWeight with CE LOCAL_PREF + BGP Communities / AS-Path Prepending.
4. Pin each IP 5-tuple on CE/Firewall to a single MSEE next-hop (mandatory for Private Endpoints!).
Asymmetric Return Leak (Dropped by Stateful FW)
